raw:
SELECT SUM(r.points) AS total_points
FROM main."results" r
JOIN main."races" ra ON r."raceId" = ra."raceId"
JOIN main."drivers" d ON r."driverId" = d."driverId"
WHERE d."surname" = 'Button'
AND ra."year" = 2009
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM main."gov_semantic_graph_version" gv 
    WHERE gv."graph_version" = 'v1'
);
